devdoc.details: This implementation is specifically for validating UniswapV2Pair and clone contracts

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to approve function. `amount` is the new allowance.

params.amount: - amount of GS LP tokens spender is given permission to spend
params.owner: - address which owns the GS LP tokens spender is being given permission to spend
params.spender: - address given permission to spend owner's GS LP tokens

Deposit(address,address,uint256,uint256).details: Event emitted when a deposit of CFMM LP tokens in exchange of GS LP tokens happens (e.g. _deposit, _mint, _depositReserves, _depositNoPull)

params.caller: - address calling the function to deposit CFMM LP tokens

ExternalSwap(uint256,uint128[],uint256,u.details: Event emitted when a flash loan is made. Purpose of flash loan is for external swaps/rebalance of loan collateral

params.amounts: - amounts of tokens held as collateral in pool that were swapped
params.liquidity: - total liquidity externally swapped in flash loan (amounts + lpTokens)
params.tokenId: - unique id that identifies the loan in question
params.txType: - transaction type. Possible values come from enum TX_TYPE

Liquidation(uint256,uint128,uint128,uint.details: Event emitted when liquidating through _liquidate or _liquidateWithLP functions

params.fee: - liquidation fee paid to liquidator in liquidity invariant units
params.tokenId: - id identifier of loan being liquidated
params.txType: - type of liquidation. Possible values come from enum TX_TYPE
params.writeDownAmt: - amount of liquidity invariant being written down

LoanCreated(address,uint256,uint16).details: Event emitted when a Loan is created

params.refId: - Reference id of post transaction activities attached to this loan
params.tokenId: - unique id that identifies the loan in question

LoanUpdated(uint256,uint128[],uint128,ui.details: Event emitted when a Loan is updated

params.liquidity: - liquidity invariant that was borrowed including accrued interest
params.rateIndex: - interest rate index of GammaPool at time loan is updated
params.tokenId: - unique id that identifies the loan in question
params.tokensHeld: - amounts of tokens held as collateral against the loan
params.txType: - transaction type. Possible values come from enum TX_TYPE

Pause(address,uint8).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

PoolUpdated(uint256,uint256,uint40,uint8.details: Event emitted when the Pool's global state variables is updated

params.accFeeIndex: - interest of total accrued interest in the GammaPool until current update
params.cfmmReserves: - reserves in CFMM. Used to track price
params.lastBlockNumber: - last block the Pool's where updated
params.lpTokenBalance: - quantity of CFMM LP tokens deposited in the pool
params.lpTokenBorrowed: - quantity of CFMM LP tokens that have been borrowed from the pool (principal)
params.lpTokenBorrowedPlusInterest: - quantity of CFMM LP tokens that have been borrowed from the pool including interest
params.txType: - transaction type. Possible values come from enum TX_TYPE

SetMaxTotalAPY(uint256).details: _maxTotalAPY - new maximum total APY charged to Borrowers

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `amount` GS LP tokens are moved from account `from` to account `to`.

params.amount: - amount of GS LP tokens being sent

Unpause(address,uint8).details: Emitted when the unpause is triggered by `account`.

Withdraw(address,address,address,uint256.details: Event emitted when a withdrawal of CFMM LP tokens happens (e.g. _withdraw, _redeem, _withdrawReserves, _withdrawNoPull)

params.assets: - amount of CFMM LP tokens withdrawn
params.caller: - address calling the function to withdraw CFMM LP tokens
params.shares: - amount of GS LP tokens redeemed

allowance(address,address).details: Returns the remaining number of GS LP tokens that `spender` will be allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through a transferFrom function call. Zero by default.

params.owner: - address which owns the GS LP tokens spender is being given permission to spend
params.spender: - address given permission to spend owner's GS LP tokens

returns._0: allowance - amount of GS LP tokens belonging to owner that spender is allowed to spend, changes with transferFrom or approve function calls

approve(address,uint256).details: Sets `amount` as the allowance of `spender` over the caller's GS LP tokens.

params.amount: - amount of GS LP tokens spender is given permission to spend
params.spender: - address given permission to spend caller's GS LP tokens

returns._0: address - CFMM LP token address used for the Vault for accounting, depositing, and withdrawing.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the amount of GS LP tokens owned by `account`.

params.account: - address whose GS LP token balance is being checked

returns._0: balance - amount of GS LP tokens held by account address

constructor.details: Initializes the contract by setting `protocolId`, `factory`, `borrowStrategy`, `repayStrategy`, `rebalanceStrategy`,`shortStrategy`, `liquidationStrategy`, `batchLiquidationStrategy`, `cfmmFactory`, and `cfmmInitCodeHash`.

convertToAssets(uint256).details: Convert GS LP tokens to GS LP tokens

returns._0: assets - CFMM LP tokens quantity that corresponds to shares quantity provided as a parameter (GS LP tokens)

convertToShares(uint256).details: Convert CFMM LP tokens to GS LP tokens

returns._0: shares - GS LP tokens quantity that corresponds to assets quantity provided as a parameter (CFMM LP tokens)

deposit(uint256,address).details: Deposit CFMM LP token and get GS LP token, does a transferFrom according to ERC4626 implementation

params.assets: - CFMM LP tokens deposited in exchange for GS LP tokens

returns.shares: - quantity of GS LP tokens sent to receiver address (`to`) for CFMM LP tokens

getLoanData(uint256).details: Get loan and convert to LoanData struct

returns._loanData: - loan data struct (same as Loan + tokenId)

maxDeposit(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of CFMM LP tokens that can be deposited into the Vault for the receiver, through a deposit call. Ignores address parameter

returns._0: maxAssets - maximum amount of CFMM LP tokens that can be deposited

maxMint(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of the GS LP tokens that can be minted for the receiver, through a mint call. Ignores address parameter

returns._0: maxShares - maximum amount of GS LP tokens that can be minted

maxRedeem(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of GS LP tokens that can be redeemed from the owner balance in the Vault, through a redeem call.

params.owner: - address that owns GS LP tokens

returns._0: maxShares - maximum amount of GS LP tokens that can be redeemed by owner address

maxWithdraw(address).details: Returns the maximum amount of CFMM LP tokens that can be withdrawn from the owner balance in the Vault, through a withdraw call.

params.owner: - address that owns GS LP tokens

returns._0: maxAssets - maximum amount of CFMM LP tokens that can be withdrawn by owner address

mint(uint256,address).details: Mint GS LP token in exchange for CFMM LP token deposits, does a transferFrom according to ERC4626 implementation

params.shares: - GS LP tokens minted from CFMM LP token deposits

returns.assets: - quantity of CFMM LP tokens sent to receiver address (`to`)

previewDeposit(uint256).details: Allows an on-chain or off-chain user to simulate the effects of their deposit at the current block, given current on-chain conditions.

returns._0: shares - expected GS LP tokens to get from assets (CFMM LP tokens) deposited

previewMint(uint256).details: Allows an on-chain or off-chain user to simulate the effects of their mint at the current block, given current on-chain conditions.

returns._0: assets - CFMM LP tokens needed to deposit to get the desired shares (GS LP tokens)

previewRedeem(uint256).details: Allows an on-chain or off-chain user to simulate the effects of their redemption at the current block, given current on-chain conditions.

returns._0: assets - expected CFMM LP tokens withdrawn if shares (GS LP tokens) burned

previewWithdraw(uint256).details: Allows an on-chain or off-chain user to simulate the effects of their withdrawal at the current block, given current on-chain conditions.

returns._0: shares - expected GS LP tokens needed to burn to withdraw desired assets (CFMM LP tokens)

redeem(uint256,address,address).details: Redeem GS LP tokens and get CFMM LP token

params.shares: - GS LP tokens requested to redeem in exchange for GS LP tokens

returns.assets: - quantity of CFMM LP tokens sent to receiver address (`to`) for GS LP tokens redeemed

totalAssets().details: Calculates and returns total CFMM LP tokens belonging to liquidity providers using state global variables. It does not update the GammaPool

returns.assets: - current total CFMM LP tokens (real and virtual) in existence in the GammaPool, including accrued interest

totalSupply().details: Get total supply of GS LP tokens, takes into account dilution through protocol revenue

returns.supply: - total supply of GS LP tokens after taking protocol revenue dilution into account

transfer(address,uint256).details: Moves `amount` GS LP tokens from the caller's account to `to`.

params.amount: - amount of GS LP tokens caller is sending
params.to: - address receiving caller's GS LP tokens

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Moves `amount` GS LP tokens from `from` to `to` using the allowance mechanism. `amount` is then deducted from the caller's allowance.

params.amount: - amount of GS LP tokens being sent
params.from: - address sending GS LP tokens (not necessarily caller's address)

withdraw(uint256,address,address).details: Withdraw CFMM LP token by burning GS LP tokens

params.assets: - amount of CFMM LP tokens requested to withdraw in exchange for GS LP tokens
params.from: - address burning its GS LP tokens

returns.shares: - quantity of GS LP tokens burned
